einzeiler: Stephen Colbert looks back at 11 years of the Late Show and welcomes Paul McCartney.
kurzfassung: Stephen Colbert hosts the final episode of The Late Show from the Ed Sullivan Theater, reflecting on eleven years on the air. He navigates a series of comedic interruptions by celebrity guests before sitting down for an extended interview with Paul McCartney. The broadcast captures the celebratory yet emotional atmosphere of a historic series finale.
stichpunkte: Stephen Colbert opens the final episode of The Late Show from the Ed Sullivan Theater after an 11-run run.
The monologue features recurring comedic bits involving surprise celebrity interruptions by Brian Cranston, Paul Rudd, and Tim Meadows.
Colbert presents his signature final segment of Meanwhile, highlighting quirky news stories and internet oddities.
Paul McCartney arrives as the final guest, bringing retirement gifts and discussing his early days in Liverpool.
McCartney recalls the Beatles' historic 1964 American debut at the very same Ed Sullivan Theater.
The legendary musician shares details about his upcoming album and his deep aversion to unwanted software updates.
Technical glitches interrupt the interview multiple times toward the end of the broadcast.
The episode concludes with promotional wrap-ups and final farewells from the team.

clips.hook: Bringing the traditional retirement gift of six bananas
clips.text: A famous actor arrives with an unusual offering intended to celebrate a retirement milestone, leading to a confusing debate over fruit counts.

clips.hook: Attending historical milestones like the moon landing
clips.text: A visiting comedian claims a presence at major historical events throughout history, casually brushing off the significance of the current farewell broadcast.

clips.hook: Applying bright orange makeup for the first American television appearance
clips.text: The legendary guest reminisces about the overwhelming experience of arriving in the United States and undergoing television preparation in the basement.

clips.hook: Frustration over constant phone software updates
clips.text: The legendary musician expresses deep annoyance at modern technology changing familiar interfaces without permission.

beschreibung: That's it for The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, everybody! When you're done listening to the final Pod Show, make sure you feast your eyes on the series finale on a TV screen (with good speakers - trust us!)
